title: Route foreign calls through a registry
description: You can trace a foreign-call node from argument evaluation to the registered target.

steps.description: FfiCall stores library and function names, signature labels, and argument nodes. CTYPES_MAP translates labels into ctypes types.
The registry keeps loaded libraries separately from Python built-ins. Its Python branch calls the selected built-in directly.
The native branch assigns a ctypes signature, prepares arguments, and calls the function. String arguments can be encoded and byte results decoded.

steps.question: Does the registry receive literal tree nodes or evaluated argument values?
steps.answer: eval_node first evaluates each argument node, then passes the resulting values.
